evidence: A satisfying settlement publishes the charter, uses private or facilitated corrections, sets asynchronous requests after 16:00, rotates chairs and publishes decisions, records exactly 3 incidents, assigns an ombudsperson, sets review at 10 business days, and reveals, credits, and justifies PF1 through PF4. A settlement lacking PF1 or PF4 would plausibly fail the incident or review/provenance checks.
